inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Are overhead electric lines or overhead utility infrastructure shown on the main site plan? If yes, what is their location relative to the proposed buildings and what clearances are shown?
